raw_text: India's Chabahar Port Deal: Strategic Imperative or Sanctions Minefield? India has signed a 10-year agreement to operate Iran's Chabahar port despite US sanctions concerns. While New Delhi frames the deal as essential for Central Asian connectivity, Iranian state media has seized on it to push narratives about American sanctions failing. Analysts warn that Tehran's influence operation around the agreement is designed to drive a wedge between India and the US on Iran policy.
clean_text: Mint reports on India's Chabahar deal amid Iranian state media influence operation pushing anti-sanctions narrative. Analysts warn Tehran using deal to drive wedge between India and US on Iran policy.
